title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS — we build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 150 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains. We operate at massive scale — processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team. This individual will be a significant and autonomous contributor, owning a major portion of the team's data architecture — solving difficult problems, building logical data models, and delivering data pipelines that are stable, performant, and consistently high quality. You will work with engineers and stakeholders across AWS to design data contracts, build ingestion flows, and deliver analytical models that increase self-service access to datasets and business effectiveness.
The ideal candidate applies appropriate technologies and best practices, writes pragmatic and maintainable code, and takes ownership of ongoing data quality. You are proficient with SQL, ETL, and data processing, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lake Formation. The candidate should have exposure to AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, and a foundational understanding of Agentic Frameworks — including autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integration. You are trusted with autonomy in ambiguous environments where data design is not well defined, able to balance customer requirements with team priorities, and passionate about building data platforms using AI to accelerate the next generation of analytics at AWS scale.
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Key job responsibilities
Identify and resolve data quality issues in processing tools, contribute to improvements and innovation, and ensure best practices in pipelines you design and maintain. For example: optimizing ingestion flows for new data sources, or building efficient transformation patterns within the team's domain.
Build and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets — ensuring solutions are testable, maintainable, and efficient while addressing security, scalability, and cost considerations.
Make appropriate technical trade-offs at the dataset level, balancing pragmatic short-term decisions with sustainable long-term approaches.
Produce high-quality code — solutions that are pragmatic, secure, maintainable, and flexible without over-engineering. Write code that engineers unfamiliar with the system can understand. Limit the use of short-term workarounds and minimize incidental complexity.
Contribute to infrastructure decisions within the team's data architecture. Efficiently manage resources (system hardware, data storage, query optimization, AWS infrastructure) and build solutions that are stable and performant.
Solve difficult problems — for example, designing data models that integrate multiple sources within the team's domain, or combining datasets to unlock new analytical capabilities. Identify issues that may lead to data inconsistency or gaps in data quality, and proactively resolve them.
Break down project work into manageable tasks, deliver independently, and collaborate effectively with peers on shared dependencies. Resolve discordant views and build consensus among team members.
Mentor peers, participate in hiring, and contribute to team knowledge-sharing
Drive data engineering best practices within the team — code quality, data certification, dependency management, and operational excellence. Establish SLAs, automate manual processes, and improve self-service access to data.
Drive improvements through code reviews, design discussions, team planning, and operational reviews.
Participate in on-call rotation and take ownership of operational health for data systems you own — contribute to monitoring, alarming, runbooks, and incident resolution.

- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience

- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using OLAP technologies experience
- Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud and ML/AI models running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the best possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.
Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.
Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.
This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.
Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.
Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs
A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.
Basic qualifications: - 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
Preferred qualifications: - 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Hardware Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Test Engineer to join the CommSys team within AMZ Leo RF/Modem Dev, responsible for validating 3GPP- and O-RAN-compliant network elements (RAN HW/SW) across lab and integration environments. The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of RF hardware, software, and automation — executing test campaigns, debugging complex system issues, and collaborating closely with integration, development, and automation teams to ensure product quality and standards compliance.
Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Key job responsibilities
Standards & Test Expertise
•Maintain strong working knowledge of 3GPP standards (LTE/5G NR) and the O-RAN stack (O-DU, O-CU, O-RU, fronthaul/midhaul interfaces, Open Fronthaul specifications).
•Stay current with conformance test specifications/lists (e.g., 3GPP TS 38.141/36.141 series, O-RAN conformance and interoperability test plans) and translate them into executable test cases.
•Understand RF, protocol stack layers (PHY/MAC/RLC/PDCP/RRC), and call-flow behavior well enough to interpret test results and identify root causes.
•Design new test cases to extend coverage for emerging 3GPP/O-RAN features, conformance requirements, and product-specific scenarios.
RF & Test Equipment
•Be familiar with RF devices and lab test equipment, including UE simulators, core network emulators, channel emulators, signal generators/analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
•Be familiar with UE evaluation test equipment and procedures used to validate device performance against 3GPP/O-RAN requirements.
•Be familiar with debug and diagnostic tools such as QXDM and other over-the-air (OTA) log analysis tools to troubleshoot UE and network behavior.
Test Execution & Data Analysis
•Plan and execute test cases on lab setups covering functional, performance, conformance, and regression testing.
•Collect, organize, and analyze test data/logs (e.g., protocol traces, KPIs, OTA logs) to assess pass/fail criteria.
•Triage test failures — distinguishing between HW faults, SW bugs, configuration issues, and test environment problems — and drive issues to resolution with the right owning team.
•Produce clear, well-documented test reports and defect write-ups for engineering and stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
•Work closely with Hardware, Software, Integration, and Automation teams to coordinate test schedules, align on test setup requirements, and resolve blocking issues quickly.
•Support the integration team in bringing up new HW and SW builds on the test bench, including initial sanity checks and bring-up validation.
•Act as a liaison between test findings and development teams, providing actionable feedback to accelerate fixes.
Lab & Test Setup Ownership
•Build, configure, and maintain new lab test setups, including equipment racking, cabling, network configuration, and tool installation.
•Continuously improve existing setups for reliability, repeatability, and test coverage.
•Perform HW and SW upgrades/updates on test equipment and devices under test (DUTs), ensuring minimal downtime.
•Debug and resolve lab/setup-level issues (connectivity, equipment faults, synchronization, environment instability) to keep test lines operational.
•Maintain accurate setup documentation/inventory (topology diagrams, equipment lists, firmware/software versions).
Scripting & Automation
•Develop and maintain scripts (Python, Shell, TCL, or similar) to automate repetitive test procedures and setup configuration tasks.
•Build or extend automated test frameworks to increase test throughput and reduce manual effort.
•Integrate automated tests into CI/CD or regression pipelines where applicable, and maintain test automation health.

- Solid understanding of 3GPP (LTE/5G NR) architecture and O-RAN network architecture and interfaces.
- Experience with lab test equipment such as UE simulators, core network emulators, channel emulators, signal generators/analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
- Experience with debug/diagnostic tools such as QXDM for OTA log analysis.
- Experience with scripting/automation (Python strongly preferred; familiarity with pytest, Robot Framework, or similar is a plus).
- Strong debugging skills across HW, SW, and network layers.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work across multidisciplinary teams.

- Familiarity with UE evaluation test equipment and device certification workflows.
- Experience designing new test cases and extending test plan coverage for new features or standards releases.
- Experience with lab automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI), and version control (Git).
- Prior experience in RAN bring-up, integration, or systems validation roles.

description:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.
Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
• Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
• Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
• Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
• Safely using material handling tools and equipment
Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided
Physical Requirements:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Essential Requirements:

• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

description:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.
You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.
• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.
• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.
• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.

- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

title: Open Source Developer Advocate, Apache Iceberg, Open Source Strategy & Marketing
description:
We are looking for an Open Source Developer Advocate to be AWS’s presence in the Iceberg community: a credible, hands-on technical voice who earns trust through contribution and turns that trust into influence. You will be the two-way bridge, representing AWS to the Iceberg community while channeling community signal, ecosystem context, and customer needs back to our engineering, product, and marketing teams.
This is a role for someone who wants to build community standing that matters. Your work will lay the foundation for AWS engineers to participate more actively in the project and to be recognized as a genuine leader in one of the most important open source projects in modern data infrastructure.
Key job responsibilities
Represent AWS in the community. Be an active, opinionated participant in Iceberg community channels, mailing lists, and core specification discussions. Build the credibility and relationships needed to influence how the project evolves.
Build contributor credibility. Participate in the project, shepherd work through the community review process, and build toward committer and PMC recognition.
Create content and evangelize. Publish blogs, tutorials, and samples, and show up at the Iceberg Summit, meetups, and conferences with hands-on talks and workshops that demonstrate AWS’s Iceberg leadership.
Amplify releases and milestones. Partner with engineering and DevRel to turn changelogs, spec progress, and feature launches (for example V3 support, multi-table transactions, and performant merge-on-read) into launch stories across community and social channels.
Grow ecosystem partnerships. Build collaborative relationships with friendly partners and vendors (for example Snowflake and Netflix) to proactively help move the project forward and to strengthen AWS’s collective voice in governance.
Be the community’s voice inside AWS. Bring developer pain points, specification direction, and ecosystem opportunities into AWS roadmap conversations. Partner with product marketing to keep positioning grounded in how developers actually talk about Iceberg.
Set the strategy. Define community health and influence metrics (committers earned, PRs merged, specification working groups joined, community relationships built) and evolve the playbook as AWS’s standing in the project grows.
About the team
About the Team
The Open Source Strategy and Marketing (OSSM) team includes veterans from top open source companies and foundations alongside passionate newcomers. We help AWS service teams effectively engage with open source communities, media, analysts, and customers—increasing the scope of our open source involvement and helping people understand why it matters.
How You'll Work
You'll own the community function for Kiro Crew: setting direction, bringing proposals, not waiting for assignments. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and product marketing: leaning on them for technical depth and roadmap context, while bringing them community signal, ecosystem context, and amplification. You'll also coordinate with developer advocacy on events, content, and partner work.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Experience contributing to or actively engaging with open source projects and their communities

title: Power Systems Engineer TIPM, Global Energy, sustainability, and Automation
description:
We are seeking a Power Systems Engineer to support electrical reliability, safety, and regulatory programs across Amazon's North American operations network. This role will be responsible for managing the five-year arc flash study refresh program, performing technical quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) of power system studies using SKM Power*Tools, and managing the electrical Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) program across North American facilities.
This position requires a strong understanding of industrial MV and LV power distribution systems. The successful candidate will combine technical engineering expertise with program management capabilities to improve electrical system reliability, reduce operational risks, and maintain electrical safety standards across a large portfolio of operating facilities.
This role requires 50% or more travel to operational facilities across North America to perform technical assessments, investigate equipment reliability issues, validate engineering studies, and support electrical safety program implementation.
Key job responsibilities
Arc Flash Study Refresh Program
- Manage the five-year arc flash study refresh program across North American facilities, ensuring timely completion and alignment with applicable electrical safety standards - across 200+ facilities annually.
- Maintain study inventories, track refresh schedules, and prioritize facilities based on electrical system changes, risk, and program requirements.
- Coordinate with third-party engineering firms and site teams to collect and validate electrical system data.
- Review study deliverables, identify deficiencies and NEC violations, propose appropriate cost-effective resolutions, and track corrective actions through closure, including arc flash labeling, relay/breaker settings adjustment, equipment replacement, and documentation updates.
- Establish program performance metrics and reporting to track study completion, deficiencies, and overall program health.
- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and develop corrective and preventive actions to address equipment failures and recurring reliability concerns.
- Investigate electrical equipment failures, recurring faults, protective device misoperations, and power distribution system reliability issues.
Power Systems Studies and Technical QA/QC
- Perform detailed technical QA/QC of power system studies using SKM Power*Tools, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, and load flow analyses.
- Independently review and validate SKM models, study assumptions, equipment parameters, protective device settings, and engineering calculations.
- Identify modeling errors, inconsistencies, and technical deficiencies in studies submitted by external engineering consultants.
- Verify study results against applicable IEEE, NFPA, and other relevant engineering standards.
- Review engineering recommendations related to protective device coordination, incident energy reduction, equipment ratings, and electrical system reliability.
- Document QA/QC findings, coordinate corrections with engineering consultants, and verify resolution before accepting final study deliverables.
- Develop and maintain standardized study review checklists, technical acceptance criteria, and QA/QC processes.
Electrical Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Program
- Manage the North American electrical LOTO program, including technical standards, implementation oversight, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
- Develop, maintain, and standardize electrical energy control requirements and procedures across operational facilities.
- Review electrical isolation procedures, equipment-specific energy control requirements, and single-line diagrams to ensure technically sound isolation practices.
- Partner with site maintenance teams and Workplace Health & Safety to implement program requirements, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions.
- Establish and monitor program performance metrics, audit findings, and corrective action closure.
- Provide technical guidance on electrical energy isolation, verification of absence of voltage, and safe electrical work practices.
- Coordinate periodic program reviews, procedural updates, and technical training requirements.
Electrical Reliability Engineering
- Provide electrical reliability engineering support for operating facilities, focusing on improving equipment performance, reducing unplanned downtime, and mitigating electrical system risks.
- Evaluate electrical equipment condition, maintenance practices, and failure trends to identify opportunities for reliability improvements.
- Support the development and optimization of preventive and condition-based maintenance strategies for electrical distribution equipment.
- Partner with site maintenance and operations teams to troubleshoot electrical system issues and implement sustainable engineering solutions.
- Provide emergency on-call support to facilities in North America.
Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years’ experience performing power system studies (Short Circuit, Protective Device Coordination, Arc Flash) for medium-voltage and low-voltage industrial electrical distribution systems
- 3+ years of hands-on proficiency with SKM Power*Tools for Windows (PTW), including power system modeling, short-circuit analysis, breaker and relay protective device coordination, and arc flash analysis.

title: Principal Engineer:  Annapurna Labs Training and Inference , Annapurna Labs, AWS Neuron SDK
description:
At Amazon, Principal Engineers are both technical leaders and hands-on builders. As Amazon's most senior individual contributors, Principal Engineers work on our hardest problems, help establish technical standards, and drive the overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies for products that delight our customers. On the AWS Neuron SDK team within Annapurna Labs, that mandate is AI model performance on Amazon's custom silicon.
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to drive AI model performance across the lifecycle on AWS Trainium — pre-training, post-training and alignment, and inference serving — with deep hands-on expertise in one of these areas and the drive to influence across all three. Neuron is Amazon's software stack: the layer between customer ML frameworks and Trainium / Inferentia silicon. The responsibilities are broad: you will have the opportunity to drive deeply into model enablement across the path from a model's first pre-training step through aligned post-training to cost- and latency-optimized serving at scale.
You will drive performance for a wide range of AI models, including the leading open-source models and direct collaborations with foundation-model developers, as well as supporting Amazon's own internal model development initiatives. This is a deep hands-on builder role: you will write code, own the forward and backward path, and make binding technical decisions, while influencing direction across the broader Neuron organization, partner teams (EC2, EKS, VPC, Bedrock, HyperPod), and leading ML customers. Annapurna offers full-stack ownership — chip to server to network to compiler to cloud — so you see your work run at customer scale, something that doesn't exist at a standalone chip company or startup. Over time, this person ends up owning the whole process end-to-end.
Key job responsibilities
As the Principal Engineer for Annapurna Labs Training and Inference, you will bring deep hands-on expertise in one of the following areas and influence across all three:
Pre-Training Performance
●Kernel optimization for ML training — forward and backward path — and drive performance out of it, with training collective algorithms (collectives, all-reduce, cross-accelerator coordination) as the primary source of gains.
●Prove top-tier performance even at small scale, and clear the path so customers can land AI models on the chip out of the box. This is a performance role, not an Applied Science role — you partner with scientists but own making it fast, not making it correct.
Post-Training & Alignment
●Supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and alignment stack that turns pretrained base models into production-grade, aligned models on Trainium — the main lever on delivered model quality and the fastest-growing, least-covered workload class on Trainium today.
●Deliver first-class RLHF/RLAIF and preference methods (PPO, GRPO, DPO/IPO/KTO, reward modeling) with training-plus-inference co-location and convergence safeguards (KL control, reward-scaling, policy-collapse detection), and native performance for the post-training ecosystem (TRL, veRL, NeMo-Aligner, TorchTitan/TorchAO, JAX).
Inference / Serving
●Inference optimization strategy within the Neuron SDK — adapting inference algorithms to Trainium's unique architecture to unlock performance existing industry approaches leave on the table, and maximizing the chip's compute and memory bandwidth to drive cost and latency improvements for large-scale model serving.
●Influence hardware-software co-design by partnering with Annapurna's chip architecture teams so future silicon incorporates lessons from production model serving.
Influence across all three
●Serve as a technical leader on demanding, cross-functional projects spanning pre-training, post-training, and inference; functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions.
●Exert technical influence across multiple teams, mentor senior engineers, and raise the technical bar across the organization.
●Balance technical leadership with strong business judgment to make the right technology choices.
About the team
The AWS Neuron team builds the software stack — compiler, runtime, and ML frameworks — that powers Amazon's Trainium and Inferentia accelerators in EC2 Trn1/2 and Inf1 servers. Our Post-Training group focuses on making Trainium the best place to align and refine frontier models: reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF), preference optimization (PPO, GRPO, DPO), and reward modeling at massive scale. We work end-to-end across a vertically integrated stack — hardware, compiler, runtime, PyTorch/JAX (XLA), and the open-source post-training ecosystem (TRL, veRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, Ray) — turning research techniques into production-grade, high-throughput systems that run efficiently across thousands of nodes.
We are a hands-on, customer-obsessed team that values deep technical ownership and collaboration across chip and software boundaries. You'll work directly with AWS customers and internal science teams to bring up new model families, remove scaling bottlenecks, and ship capabilities that let builders post-train and align large language and multi-modal models faster and more cost-effectively on AWS.

description:
Every day, hundreds of Amazon teams across Retail, Prime, Prime Video, Music, Alexa, and more reach customers through email, push, SMS, and messaging apps. Outbound Communications runs that marketplace, at the scale of hundreds of millions of customers and billions of messages, through everyday sending and Amazon's largest events: Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days, and the holidays. Each message competes for finite customer attention. The marketplace grows when every message earns more of it: more customers open, click, and buy, and fewer opt out.
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical to lead growth for this marketplace. You'll own click-through rate, conversion, and incremental sales per message across channels, and the technical products that move them: personalization and recommendations in messages, send-time and channel optimization, new creative and interactive experiences, conversational and messaging channels, and the experimentation engine that tells us what works.
You'll work backwards from the customer. You'll find where messages fail to earn engagement, form hypotheses, and run a high-velocity experimentation program with engineering and science. You'll ship the winners as platform capabilities that every sending team can use, not one-off campaign tweaks. You'll measure growth honestly, on clicks, conversions, incremental OPS, and long-term customer value, not opens, and you'll balance short-term lift against opt-outs and customer trust.

- Own the growth strategy, roadmap, and goals for Outbound's customer attention marketplace: CTR, conversion, incremental OPS per message, and engagement across email, push, SMS, and messaging channels.
- Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program. Set the hypothesis backlog, prioritize by expected impact, and make A/B and multi-armed testing fast, trustworthy, and self-service for every sending team.

- Define the growth funnel and its instrumentation end to end, from delivered to opened, clicked, converted, and retained. Make the data reconcilable, real-time where it matters, and attributable to the module, content, and decision that drove it.
- Grow the addressable audience: opt-in and permission growth for new channels, reactivation of lapsed customers, and deliverability and reach improvements.
- Turn winning experiments into platform capabilities. Write PR/FAQs and requirements, make build-vs-buy and architecture trade-offs with engineering leaders, and drive adoption across partner teams.
- Set growth tenets and guardrails, such as opt-out, complaint, and frequency limits, so growth never comes at the cost of customer trust.
- Influence senior leaders across Retail, Prime, and partner businesses with data and written narratives, and report growth results and learnings in the Outbound business reviews.
- Raise the bar for growth and experimentation practice across Outbound, and mentor product managers.

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, Mechanical Infrastructure, Data Center Engineering
description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a high-impact Principal Product Manager with a deep specialization in mechanical infrastructure to define and execute the product strategy for our next-generation infrastructure and facility systems. As a technical leader, you will bridge the gap between abstract business/scale goals and physical engineering realities, ensuring our designs are fit for purpose, scalable, and cost-effective.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
As a Principal Mechanical Product Manager you will be responsible for defining the "what" and "why" of our mechanical strategy, ensuring alignment across cross-functional teams, and driving critical decisions even in the face of complexity or resistance. The leader in this role has the ability to make tough calls, stand behind decisions, and navigate obstacles. You must be comfortable pushing back on stakeholders and driving alignment.
You are the voice of the business at the front of the pipeline — the person who decides which platforms earn the organization’s capacity, and why. You own the customer need each platform serves, its system-level requirements, and how it fits into the broader roadmap. You own the technical requirements strategy that sets the foundation for timing, cost, and execution. You own the mechanism by which field, cost, and customer signals are collected, converted into requirements for a new platform or its next revision, and prioritized against everything else in the portfolio. You bring rigor to the front end so that platforms enter the pipeline with validated business requirements, clear boundaries, and a defensible priority.
Key job responsibilities
- System-Level Ownership: Own and understand how mechanical designs impact the broader infrastructure (e.g., cooling, electrical, structural). Evaluate how new business requests affect the entire fleet and propose integrated solutions.
- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and communicate a multi-year vision, strategy, and product roadmap for advanced mechanical infrastructure products. Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps.
- Modular Standardization: Standardize complex mechanical systems into modular, prefabricated skids to compress on-site data center construction and commissioning timelines.
- Global Compliance & Localization: Ensure the core mechanical product line remains compatible across multiple global geographic zones, accommodating varying regional building codes, environmental constraints, and extreme climate variations.
- Strategic Alignment & Vision: Lead the definition of challenges at the facility and product levels. Ensure all stakeholders are aligned on the path forward, particularly when navigating complex transitions.
- Value Engineering & Decision Making: Actively challenge existing assumptions regarding cost and complexity.
- Technical Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert who can evaluate technical trade-offs.
- Systems Thinking: Ability to see the big picture and understand the upstream/downstream impacts of mechanical design choices on electrical and structural systems.
A day in the life
Your day moves between signal and strategy. You might begin by synthesizing customer needs and cost data into a sharpened requirement for a platform’s next revision, then join a pre-production readiness review where you and a Principal Engineer pressure-test whether an existing product can serve a new customer need or whether a new variant is truly justified. In the afternoon you might defend a platform’s priority against competing portfolio demands in front of leadership, armed with the business case for why it earns the org’s capacity.
Your internal stakeholders span the full lifecycle: Principal Engineers, TPMs, product team, engineering, sourcing, industrialization and construction partners. The problems you solve are the hardest ones at the front of the funnel: what the business actually needs, whether we already have it, and what it is worth relative to everything else.

That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing

How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.
The systems you build here don't sit in a backlog — they're load-bearing for the internet: S3, EBS, and Glacier storing the data behind modern AI and analytics; Redshift, EMR, and SageMaker turning that data into insight; and the next generation of high-performance caching making all of it fast. title: Propulsion Lab Engineer, Amazon Leo GNC & Propulsion
description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.
The Propulsion Lab Engineer will be a key member of Amazon Leo's Propulsion Manufacturing team, combining deep technical expertise with strong collaborative skills. This role will lead the development and optimization of electric propulsion manufacturing infrastructure while working across engineering disciplines. The ideal candidate will drive technical solutions for manufacturing challenges, implement process controls, and maintain critical lab equipment, while effectively partnering with Design, Quality, Systems, and Test engineers to translate requirements into robust manufacturing processes. Success in this role requires both hands-on technical leadership and the ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration to achieve manufacturing excellence.
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Key job responsibilities
• Build or Test development and production hardware in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and engineering drawings, including component and subsystem fabrication (machining, 3D printing, rapid prototyping).
• Conduct detailed inspections and testing of production and reworked hardware to validate functionality, performance, and conformance to specifications.
• Navigate MES/SAP systems in support of production operations.
• Execute failure analysis and root cause investigations on non-conforming propulsion hardware.
• Execute hardware rework tasks as needed.
• Work with Responsible Engineers and Mfg. Engineers to diagnose and solve issues resulting in yield and throughput improvements.
• Identify and/or lead process improvement initiatives to increase rework efficiency, reduce scrap rates, maintain 5S standards and improve first-pass yield.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve integration challenges, validate rework procedures, provide design-for-manufacturability feedback, and implement corrective actions.
• Support the development and improvement of assembly and test procedures based on hands-on build experience and design-for-manufacturability feedback.
• Take loosely defined requests from engineers, clarify requirements, and develop a concrete plan of lab work owned through completion.
• Prioritize and manage a personal work queue against team goals, sequence builds and tests to prevent blockers and keep multiple efforts moving concurrently with limited supervision.
• Coordinate task execution within assigned work streams, track progress, and flag schedule or resource risks.
• Support and maintain Test and/or Mfg. team tool program for development and production stations.
• Collaborate with Amazon Leo facility team and support preventative maintenance for development and production test chambers.
• Support with Propulsion lab organization and floor space layout.
• Operate shop tools and lab equipment effectively and safely.
• Train and mentor team members on rework techniques, lab systems, tools, safety protocols, and quality standards.
• Document technical issues, rework procedures, resolutions, and lessons learned.
• Track and report on rework metrics including cycle time, yield rates, defect trends, and scrap reduction.
A day in the life
The Propulsion Lab Engineer will perform a variety of tasks involving support for both Mfg. and Test infrastructure and executing on these actions. Lab Engineers will work closely with both Technicians and Manufacturing/Responsible Engineers to identify process improvements to improve both Mfg. and Test efficiency and optimization. The Lab Engineer will actively monitor Mfg./Test infrastructure, equipment health, station status, and process performance with the intent to proactively identify and action issues that could impact the efficiency, throughput, and/or overall health of the department before they escalate into production blockers.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced production environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment for quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.
About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team is responsible for the design, development, and testing of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.
Basic qualifications: - Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency and creating new processes when necessary
- • Associate’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience in a related STEM field.
- • 4+ years of experience in the assembly, integration, calibration, and test of aerospace hardware in a development or production environment.
- • Experience executing qualification test campaigns for aerospace or defense hardware.
- • Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems, and systems.
- • Experience with hardware rework, assembly/disassembly, or precision manufacturing operations.
- • Experience with precision torque, measurement, and inspection devices (e.g., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters).
- • Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency, including managing lab resources, equipment, and supplies.
- • Experience tracking and coordinating lab tasks across concurrent activities using ticketing or project management tools.
- • Experience contributing to and developing engineering documentation, procedures, and SOPs for complex working processes.
- • Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Preferred qualifications: - • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent STEM field.
- • Experience working with vacuum and/or pressurized gas systems.
- • Experience with test execution software such as Test Stand, LabVIEW, and Python.
- • Experience with testing of production hardware designed for space environments.
- • Experience building, commissioning, and maintaining test racks and testing infrastructure.
- • Experience with tube fabrication and orbital tube welding (OTW).
- • Experience scheduling and delivering high-impact test and Mfg. infrastructure scope.
- • Experience working with FOD, ESD-sensitive hardware, and cleanroom requirements, including contamination control protocols.
- • 2+ years of experience contributing to or owning a calibration and equipment tracking system.
- • Experience supporting automated test sequences or system characterization routines.
- • Background in continuous improvement frameworks (Six Sigma, Lean, 5S).
- • Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, and visualization tools (Tableau, Quick, Grafana).
- • Experience running user trials, beta testing, field testing, or collecting customer feedback.
- • Experience working with hardware and software teams for setting up, testing, and troubleshooting prototype devices.
- • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to document technical findings clearly.

title: Reliability Engineer, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Reliability Engineer to drive design for reliability in Amazon Leo hardware systems. This role will be responsible for developing and leading various reliability activities during product development and through the life of the product. It will require interfacing closely with subsystem teams, providing technical input and guidance on designs, and supporting as needed for reliability analysis and testing.
The ideal candidate will have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based models to develop and implement both analytical and empirical solutions for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during the product design, manufacturing, testing and deployment stages. The candidate should be able to drive Amazon Leo's requirements by carrying out stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical and mechanical stresses in order to identify over-stress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. They should also be comfortable in assessing electronics manufacturing process related quality/reliability issues.
At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification, support vendor selection and define component qualification requirements. The candidate will also be expected to use their knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, electronic component derating, as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical quality and reliability metrics.
At the system level, the candidate will support development of system level reliability models and perform reliability assessments and risk analyses for optimization of design. The candidate will be also be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and on orbit data analytics.

- Define sample sizes and test specifications to demonstrate target reliability and confidence numbers
- Develop subsystem reliability models and establish reliability allocations across components to meet reliability targets.
- Review, guide, and support subsystem team component selections, derating and FMEAs
- Support component and manufacturing process qualification
- Drive root cause investigation and failure analysis for hardware failures

title: Senior Data Engineer, AWS Analytics Engineering
description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS — we build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 150 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.
We operate at massive scale — processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team. This individual will own 3-5 data domains end-to-end, operate hundreds of pipelines, and drive architectural improvements that impact how AWS leadership makes decisions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to design data contracts, build ingestion flows, and deliver analytical models that serve the entire organization.
The ideal candidate is a technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, takes a long-term architectural view, and consistently delivers exemplary solutions. You are an expert with SQL, ETL, and data processing, with experience leveraging cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lambda. The candidate should have hands-on experience with AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, and a strong understanding of designing and building Agentic Frameworks — including autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integration. You are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, able to think big while paying careful attention to detail, and passionate about building data platforms using AI to accelerate the next generation of analytics at AWS scale.
Key job responsibilities
Identify limitations and opportunities in data processing tools, drive improvements and innovation, define data processing guidelines, and ensure best practices in all pipelines designed and reviewed. For example: redesigning ingestion frameworks to handle new AWS service telemetry data, or building reusable transformation patterns adopted across multiple teams.
Define and own data architecture at the team level — ensuring architecture effectively matches business problems and data challenges with security, scalability, and cost effectiveness. Show good judgment making technical trade-offs between short-term technology needs and long-term business needs.
Produce exemplary code — solutions that are easily usable by customers, inventive, secure, easily maintainable, appropriately scalable, and extensible. Build solutions that are easy for others to contribute to. Work to simplify, optimize, and remove bottlenecks.
Define and own infrastructure architecture at the team level. Anticipate data management and access patterns, evolve the technology stack to remove bottlenecks, and deliver systems that are secure, scalable, and long lasting. Define team-level guidelines and best practices for infrastructure management and automation.
Solve complex ambiguous problems — for example, designing cross-domain data models that unify billing, usage, and service telemetry data, or combining multiple datasets to solve problems that couldn't be solved before. Spot areas that might lead to customer confusion, data misinterpretation, or gaps in data contracts.
Effectively split project work into parallel tasks that can be performed by themselves and others and reassembled successfully. Drive to completion projects with dependencies on peers or other teams.
Influence related teams' data architecture and software design. Provide technical assessments for promotions. Actively mentor and develop others. Build consensus when confronted with discordant views.
Drive data engineering best practices — Data Discovery, Naming Conventions, Operational Excellence, Data Security. Ensure team's data is auditable, available, and accessible.
Proactively fix data architecture deficiencies and propose larger projects which may require the work of other teams. Drive improvements through code review, design discussions, team planning, and operational reviews.
Participate in on-call rotation and own operational health of data systems — establish monitoring, alarming, runbooks, and SLA tracking. Drive continuous improvement in reliability and incident response.
Basic qualifications: - 7+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
- Experience mentoring team members on best practices
- Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
- Experience building data products incrementally and integrating and managing data sets from multiple sources
- Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe data modeling decisions and data engineering strategy
- Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring other engineers for best practices on data engineering
- Experience with MPP databases such as Amazon Redshift
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- 5+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
Preferred qualifications: - Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience operating large data warehouses
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience with enterprise-scale infrastructure or development-based cloud programs/projects in a related industry
- Experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets, or experience with software development lifecycle

Identify seller needs and design delightful solutions with measurable impact.

description:

In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.
In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Core Search
description:
The Amazon Search Navigation AI team helps customers go from a broad search intent to the few products that fit their needs, so they can make a confident purchase decision. We generate highly relevant, context-aware, and personalized search refinements. We also decide the order they appear in across Amazon's Search Navigation experiences, guiding customers to the most relevant results. The team owns Search Navigation's P0 metrics and defect guardrails, which keep performance and reliability high for hundreds of millions of customers.
We are reinventing search refinement with generative AI. Our recently launched Smart Refinement experience uses large language models (LLMs) served online to turn product specifications into natural-language suggestions that match how customers think, such as "for colder weather" or "lightweight for travel." Next, we are building multi-turn, conversational refinement, where each interaction builds on the last and helps customers narrow their intent in fewer steps.
We build and run the engineering systems behind this work, including the Navigation Experience Service (NES). NES connects to Amazon's core search systems, serves more than 3 billion queries worldwide every day, and runs real-time LLM inference at global scale under strict latency and cost limits. Our platform supports launches of new navigation content and UIs, and it makes fast offline and online experimentation possible.
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to be a technical leader on the team. You will shape the architecture of our Search Navigation platform, including the systems that serve LLMs in real time, lead complex projects that span multiple teams, and work closely with Applied Scientists to take LLM innovations from research into production. You are comfortable with ambiguity, you set a high bar for engineering, and you are curious about applied science.

- Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of large-scale, distributed, low-latency services that power Amazon Search Navigation experiences worldwide
- Own the technical direction for online LLM serving in Search Navigation, including GPU and accelerator inference, request-time personalization, asynchronous rendering, caching, and cost and latency optimization
- Drive the engineering roadmap for Smart Refinement and multi-turn conversational refinement, scaling from initial launch to a much larger share of search traffic
- Build safe, reliable GenAI experiences with layered safeguards: input triggering and exclusion controls, output validation and filtering, and graceful fallbacks

title: Senior Software Development Manager, Amazon Internal Auth Services
description:
Amazon's Internal Authentication organization is looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the teams that build and operate the authentication broker and third-party identity provider used across the company. These systems are distinct from Amazon's primary employee identity provider: where that system establishes who you are, the systems you will own determine how that identity is brokered, federated, and extended to the thousands of services and third-party products that make up Amazon's internal ecosystem.
This is a multi-site leadership role spanning Dublin, Herndon, and Seattle. You will own the services that enable single sign-on across a diverse and growing application landscape, manage identity and access for Amazon's non-employee workforce (contractors, partners, and alumni), provide self-service onboarding for application teams integrating with centralized authentication, and extend broker-mediated authentication into Amazon's emerging AI agent ecosystem.
Key job responsibilities
Lead and grow multiple software development teams across three sites, building a unified engineering culture across geographies and time zones.
Own the technical strategy, roadmap, and delivery for authentication brokering, third-party identity management, and application onboarding.
Build and operate systems at Amazon scale with the reliability expectations that come with being in the critical path of nearly every internal service.
Partner closely with security, compliance, and policy teams to ensure access controls keep pace with a growing and evolving threat landscape.
Make pragmatic tradeoffs between usability and security, knowing that friction in authentication has real costs to productivity and that gaps in authentication have real costs to the company.
Hire, develop, and retain strong engineering talent across all three sites, with particular attention to building leadership depth and technical bench strength.
Represent your organization's priorities and technical direction to senior leadership, translating complex identity and access problems into clear business terms.
A day in the life
Your days are spent setting technical strategy for systems that operate at company-wide scale, partnering with security, infrastructure, and application teams across Amazon and external partners to solve hard problems in authentication and identity, and coaching a strong engineering team that builds the solutions. The work is a mix of long-term architectural thinking and short-term judgment calls where security, usability, and partner needs intersect.
About the team
You will own the authentication broker that sits between identity providers and the thousands of relying applications across Amazon, enabling seamless single sign-on without requiring every service to integrate directly with every identity source. You will own the purpose-built identity provider for Amazon's non-employee population: contractors, partners, vendor collaborators, and alumni who need controlled, auditable access with distinct security and lifecycle requirements. And you will own the self-service portal and tooling that lets thousands of application teams onboard to centralized authentication correctly and efficiently.
Basic qualifications: - 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
Preferred qualifications: - Experience with any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing
- Experience building systems that serve both human users and programmatic/automated clients.
- Demonstrated ability to balance security requirements with usability and developer experience.
- Experience with zero-trust architectures or network perimeter evolution.
- Familiarity with federation protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth), identity providers, and authentication broker architectures.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our US Government customers in the Northern Virginia / DC Metro area. (Relocation assistance is available.)
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
As a Solutions Architect on the National Security team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to your Intelligence Community customers. You are the “face of Amazon” to your customers, and they will consult you regarding a broad variety of technical challenges that are complex and mission-critical. You can build sample solutions, “think big,” and provide architecture designs and cloud enablement strategy that suit your customer’s business and technical needs. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence external stakeholders (our government customers) and internal AWS teams like Sales and Platform Engineering.
National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.
Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.
